FAQ

Didn't find an answer? Message us and we'll reply within an hour.

Ask a question
How much does a website cost?

It depends on the number of pages, languages and features. We'll give you an exact price after a short look at your brief, before any prepayment.

How can you work so fast?

Design, development and copy run in parallel, and we start once we have all the materials, so nothing sits waiting.

What if you miss the deadline?

If it's our fault, the price drops by 10% for every day we're late, up to 30%. Revisions until the agreed result are free. It's written into the contract.

What do you need from us?

Texts, photos, your logo and domain access. If something's missing, we'll show you how to get it quickly.

How do payments work?

Your choice: 50% upfront and 50% on delivery, or 40%, 30% and 30% by stage.

Will we own the website?

Yes. The site runs on your domain, and after launch all files and access stay with you.

Can the site be in several languages?

Yes. The MaxiPharm Expert site is in Russian, English and Uzbek, Samarcande Voyage is in French, and the XizmatTop interface supports four languages.

Tell us about your project

We'll reply within an hour, clarify the brief and give you a timeline and price. You can simply send a link to your Instagram or current website.
